generalization_hardening_this_round.summary: Audited (never tuned directly against) Blind v12's 4 critical misses at an abstract failure-category level and fixed the identified root causes generically.
fixes: candidate_generator.py: bounded must-not-miss reinjection restoring the pool-trim's own documented (but previously unenforced) guarantee that a dangerous:true safety-net diagnosis is never silently dropped to hit the size budget

differential.py: analogous two-stage final-differential safety reinjection (Stage A: small fixed must-not-miss list, unconditional; Stage B: any other dangerous diagnosis with real supporting evidence), gated to competition-retrieval mode, restricted to evicting only zero-evidence filler entries

differential.py: soft cap on stacked typical_feature contribution (_TYPICAL_FEATURE_CONTRIBUTION_CAP = one confirmatory finding's worth) so keyword volume cannot outweigh one decisive confirmatory finding
objective_evidence.py: broadened generic qualitative vocabulary for every single-abnormal-direction qualitative-only lab (troponin/D-dimer/CRP/lipase/ketones/beta-hCG/urinalysis)

matching.py: moved FEATURE_ALIASES/alias-aware matching to a shared module and wired candidate_generator.py's risk_match/medication_match to use it too (previously only differential.py's scoring did, so an aliased risk/medication phrase could score correctly once present but never pull a diagnosis INTO the pool by itself)

action_selector.py: management_relevance no longer treats every remaining discriminator for an ALREADY decisively-supported dangerous diagnosis as automatically management-changing (still full priority for that diagnosis's own minimum_workup)

knowledge/diseases/neuro.json: aphasia added as a stroke typical_feature distinct from slurred speech (dysarthria); knowledge/diseases/abdominal_gi.json: antiplatelet use added as a gi_bleeding risk_factor
generalization_hardening_this_round.regression_status: No regression: full pytest 520/1, tuning/held-out/generalization-v2/stress all 100% scored accuracy / 0% critical miss (unchanged), retrieval recall floor unchanged, adversarial all PASS, leakage scan clean.

blind_v13.note: MATERIALLY WORSE than Blind v12 (64.0%/77.8%/22.2%), not an improvement. Flagged as the top priority for a future round.
